catches: Automatic Delivery tier: $100 each — friend must be a new automatic heating-oil delivery customer, or new automatic propane customer with whole house heat.
Will Call tier: $50 each — friend must be a new credit-approved will-call heating-oil customer (minimum 100 gallon order).
Propane Auxiliary Heat tier: $50 each — minimum 100 gallons per year required.
Credits are applied to fuel accounts, not paid as cash; subject to credit approval.

steps: Go to the Tevis Energy Refer A Friend page.
Submit your friend's information (or have them mention you at sign-up).
Your friend becomes a new Tevis Energy customer on automatic or qualifying will-call delivery.
You receive a $100 (automatic) or $50 (will-call/auxiliary) account credit; your friend gets the same amount off their first order.
